### When Our Obedience Comes to Naught
Author: Jennifer Slattery
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wholly-loved/when-our-obedience-comes-to-naught-wholly-loved-september-6.html
Passage: Jeremiah 20:9
Points:
- Every believer receives a unique divine calling, but faithfully answering it rarely unfolds the way we expect.
- Following God's directives does not shield us from hardship, public rejection, or feelings of abandonment.
- Like Jeremiah after being beaten and humiliated, we may feel tempted to give up and remain silent.
- God's Word and calling within the believer ultimately prove stronger than wounded feelings and distress.
- True perseverance comes not through our own strength, but through surrendering to Christ who sustains us.
